description: Add sanitized Markdown in a fixed frame. Omit height to auto-size from content, width, style, table wrapping, and images (80-1200px); content needing more than 1200px returns a clipping warning unless allowScroll=true. Explicitly smaller frames require allowScroll=true. HTTP(S) and same-origin relative images are allowed by default, but a successful mutation does not prove a remote image loaded; verify rendered output before claiming it did.

allowImages.description: Whether supported image references may render. This setting does not prove that a remote image loaded.

allowScroll.description: Set true only when a deliberately compact, internally scrolling Markdown frame is required.

markdown.description: Markdown source displayed inside this fixed-size frame.

width.description: Visible frame width. Set explicitly when composing a multi-column layout.
